benchmark.scope: Original ABB smoke leaf module only; excludes endpoint generation and full coverage assembly

projection_scope: Linear extrapolation from one 20-leaf low-parameter sample. Excludes fresh endpoint and parameter proofs, coverage, padded replay, other regions and integration; not a full-job runtime estimate.
feasibility: Sample fits comfortably. Full F1 and nonapex12 feasibility at this memory cap is untested; their multi-worker cluster runs exhausted 64 GiB.
cluster_caches: Do not count Linux build artifacts as checked macOS results without validating portability and source dependencies.
